elements.description:
Cart APIs. For authenticated customers, cart is managed by customer_id. For guests, cart is managed only by X-Guest-Token.

Guest requests use only the X-Guest-Token header.
X-Cart-Token, Cart-Token, cart_token cookie and other legacy token mechanisms are not used.

Guest token is created from the common Settings API endpoint: POST /v1/guest-token.
The same X-Guest-Token is used for Cart, Compare and Favorites.

If X-Guest-Token is not sent to cart write endpoints, backend can create a new active guest cart and return data.token in the cart response. However, recommended frontend flow is to create a guest token once with POST /v1/guest-token and send it in all guest Cart, Compare and Favorites requests.
elements.basePathNote: These endpoints work with the /v1 prefix.

X-Guest-Token.description: The only token header for guest Cart, Compare and Favorites. It is not sent in the request body and is used only as a header.

Authorization.description: Bearer token for authenticated customers. Example: Authorization: Bearer {token}

get.description:
Returns the active cart for an authenticated customer or a guest.
For authenticated customers, the active cart is resolved by customer_id.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.
If token is missing and backend creates a new guest cart, the response returns data.token. The client must send that token as X-Guest-Token in the next guest Cart, Compare and Favorites requests.

post.description:
Adds a product variation to the cart.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.
Recommended flow: create a guest token once with POST /v1/guest-token and send it as X-Guest-Token.
If the same variation already exists in the cart, qty is increased.

qty.description: Quantity to add. Default is 1, minimum is 1.

patch.description:
Updates cart item quantity by product variation route parameter.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.
qty is required.
If qty is 0, the item is removed from the cart.

qty.description: Final quantity for this cart item. Use 0 to remove the item.

delete.description:
Removes a product variation from the cart.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.

post.description:
Validates promo code status, date, usage limit and minimum total rules.
This endpoint does not apply the promo code to the cart.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.

Validates the promo code.
If validation succeeds, cart.promo_code_id is set and totals are recalculated.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.

delete.description:
Sets cart.promo_code_id to null and recalculates totals.
For guests, only the X-Guest-Token header is used.

elements.description:
Compare APIs. For authenticated customers, compare works by customer_id. For guests, compare works only by X-Guest-Token.

Guest requests use only the X-Guest-Token header.
X-Compare-Token, Compare-Token, compare_token cookie and other legacy token mechanisms are not used.

Guest token is created from the common Settings API endpoint: POST /v1/guest-token.
The same X-Guest-Token is used for Cart, Compare and Favorites.

Compare is managed only by product variation through product_variation_id. The toggle endpoint adds the variation if it does not exist in compare, and removes it if it already exists.

During Login/Register, if X-Guest-Token is sent, guest compare items can be merged into the customer account.

Variation filters are returned in the same grouped structure as Product Detail API. Filters are sorted by filter sort_order and values are sorted by value sort_order.

Authorization.description: Bearer token for authenticated customers using customer-api guard.

X-Guest-Token.description: The only token header for guest Cart, Compare and Favorites. It is not sent in the request body and is used only as a header.

get.description:
Returns paginated compare items. Default per_page is 20.
For authenticated customers, items are returned by customer_id.
For guests, items are returned only by X-Guest-Token.
If no token is sent for a guest request, an empty list is returned.
Recommended flow: create a guest token once with POST /v1/guest-token and send it as X-Guest-Token in all guest Cart, Compare and Favorites requests.

per_page.description: Items per page. Minimum 1, maximum 100, default 20.

post.description:
Sends product_variation_id.
For authenticated customers, compare works by customer_id.
For guests, compare works by X-Guest-Token.
The response returns action: created or deleted.

Recommended flow: create a guest token once with POST /v1/guest-token and send it as X-Guest-Token.
If a guest request does not include a token, backend can generate a token and return it as data.token. The client must send that token as X-Guest-Token in the next guest Cart, Compare and Favorites requests.

When action is created, compare.variation.filters is returned in grouped and sorted format. Filters are sorted by product_filters.sort_order and values are sorted by product_filter_values.sort_order.

post.description: Creates a new customer account and sends an email verification OTP. If the email already exists and is not verified, the existing customer record is updated and a new email verification OTP is sent. If the email is already verified, registration is blocked. Login is not allowed until the email is verified.

date_of_birth.description: Customer date of birth. Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD.

email.description: Customer email address. The email must be unique for verified customers. If an unverified customer exists with the same email, that record is updated instead of creating a duplicate record.

message: Email is not verified. Please verify your email using the OTP code.

200.message: If the email is registered, a password reset code has been sent.

email: Please enter a valid email address.

post.description: Handles all customer OTP verification flows. For email verification, send type=email_verification. For password reset, send type=password_reset together with password and password_confirmation. OTP must be exactly 4 digits. Invalid attempts increase the attempt counter. Used, expired, or invalid OTP codes are rejected.

type.description: OTP verification type. Allowed values: email_verification, password_reset.

password.description: New password. Required only when type=password_reset. Password policy is applied.

password_confirmation.description: New password confirmation. Required only when type=password_reset.

email: User with this email was not found.

post.description: Sends a new email verification OTP if the customer email is not verified. If the email does not exist or is already verified, the endpoint still returns a 200 response for security and idempotency.

200.message: Verification code has been resent successfully.

email: Please enter a valid email address.

elements.description: Main page constructor API. Returns the sections configured by the admin in their defined order. Sections may consist of sliders, banners, product blocks, show_on_main_page categories, show_on_main_page services, and dynamic blocks based on menu type.
elements.basePathNote: This endpoint works under the /v1 prefix inside a route group. The endpoint is public. Language selection is handled through the Content-Language header. Sections in the response are returned according to the sort_order defined in the admin panel.

Content-Language.description: Language header. Example: az | en | ru. Middleware sets the application locale according to this header.

Authorization.description: Not required for this endpoint. This is a public endpoint.

get.description: Returns the constructor sections for the main page. Each section is returned with its own source_type, and the actual data for that block is placed inside the data field. Inactive sections are not returned. Ordering is based on the sort_order defined in the admin panel. If a limit exists, the number of items returned inside each block is restricted accordingly.

notes: Sections are returned only from rows in the main_page_sections table where status=Active.
The response order is based on the sort_order defined through drag-and-drop in the admin panel.
When source_type=slider, active and ordered sliders are returned.
When source_type=banner, source_reference is used as the banner position. For example: 991199 = Home Page 1, 992299 = Home Page 2, or banner positions based on category/menu IDs.
When source_type=product_block, source_reference is the product_blocks.id. Products are selected dynamically according to that block's rules.
Inside a product block, the rules category_scope, brand_scope, product_scope, and only_discount_products are applied.
When source_type=show_on_main_page_categories, only active root menus with menus.show_on_main_page=1 and menus.type=categories are returned.
When source_type=show_on_main_page_services, only active root menus with menus.show_on_main_page=1, menus.type=content, and menus.view_type=Services are returned.
When source_type=menu_type, menus.type is filtered according to the selected menu_type. If menu_view_type is provided, menus.view_type is also added to the filter.
In menu type sections, categories may be intentionally placed at the end through separate option ordering on the admin side.
When limit is null, the source uses its own default behavior. If a limit value exists, the returned item count is restricted to that value.
Section title is multilingual, and in the admin panel it is required for required languages.
This endpoint is designed as a unified feed for the main page. The frontend should render the appropriate component according to source_type.

elements.description: Menu list, scoped menu trees for header, footer, main_page_menus, menu detail by type, included menu items, and menu based public form submit APIs.
elements.basePathNote: These endpoints work under the /v1 route group prefix. They are public endpoints and do not require authorization. By default, only active menus (status=true) are returned.

get.summary: Menu list grouped by main_page_menus, header, and footer
get.description: Returns active menus grouped into main_page_menus, header, and footer. Each grouped tree is scoped by its own visibility flag. For example, header contains only menus where in_header=true, and every child inside header must also have in_header=true. If a parent has in_header=true but a child has in_header=false, that child is not returned. The same rule applies to main_page_menus by show_on_main_page=true and footer by in_footer=true. Query filters can still be used. If in_header=true, in_footer=true, or show_on_main_page=true is sent, the response returns only the requested sections. Menu translation fields are selected by locale and fallback locale. Field-level fallback is applied, for example if title is empty in the selected locale, fallback locale or another available translation value is used. Included menu items are returned inside each menu resource as included_items when available.

status.description: Filter by menu status. If not provided, status=true is applied by default.

in_header.description: Filter by header visibility. If true is sent, the response returns header only. Menus and children inside header must all have in_header=true.

show_on_main_page.description: Filter by main page visibility. If true is sent, the response returns main_page_menus only. Menus and children inside main_page_menus must all have show_on_main_page=true.

in_footer.description: Filter by footer visibility. If true is sent, the response returns footer only. Menus and children inside footer must all have in_footer=true.

type.description: Filter by menu type. Examples: categories, content, contact, link, faq, teamstaff, logospartners, form, grids, photo_gallery, video_gallery, files.

view_type.description: Exact match filter by menus.view_type. If it is empty in database, the API returns default as view_type.

parent_id.description: Filter by parent_id. Example: parent_id=5 returns only children of that parent.

link.description: Exact match filter by menu_translations.link. If the value does not start with /, it is normalized automatically.

locale.description: Locale code used for translated menu fields. If not provided, the application locale is used.

with_children.description: Accepted for backward compatibility. The current grouped response always returns scoped menu trees for main_page_menus, header, and footer.

get.summary: Menu detail by type with optional data_slug
get.description: Finds a menu by link and calls a type-specific handler based on menu.type. If data_slug is sent, the endpoint returns detail data from the selected menu type data source. For example, for type=grids and view_type=blog, data_slug can be a concrete post slug and the endpoint returns that post detail instead of the list. If a handler is not found, 404 is returned. The menu object always returns view_type; if it is empty in database, default is returned. If locale query parameter is provided, menu translation fields are returned using locale and fallback locale. Field-level fallback is applied for title and description. Included menu, slider, and brand items are returned in included_items.

link.description: Menu link or slug. It is searched by menu_translations.link. If it does not start with /, it is normalized automatically.

data_slug.description: Optional data detail selector based on menu type. Example: for type=grids and view_type=blog, this is the post slug and returns one post detail instead of the list.

page.description: Pagination page for list-based menu types when data_slug is not sent.

per_page.description: Pagination per page for list-based menu types when data_slug is not sent. Default is 12, maximum is 100.

locale.description: Locale code used for translated menu fields. If not provided, the application locale is used.

post.summary: Submit dynamic form response by menu
post.description: The {menu_uuid_or_id} parameter can be a Menu uuid or Menu id. The body accepts answers as an object in label_id => value format. Validation is dynamic and is checked on the server side according to form_labels.type and is_required rules. On success, the data is stored in form_responses. Admin panel can view submitted responses, while the public API only creates responses.

menu_uuid_or_id.description: Menu uuid or Menu id. Example: 233 or 26be667d-9a60-4c3f-983a-0a008329383f.

answers.description: Dynamic answers where key is label_id and value is data according to label type. Examples: textbox/string, textarea/string, numeric/number, checkbox/boolean, multi_selectbox/array.

get.description: Mövcud səbətə əsasən checkout üçün lazım olan məlumatları qaytarır. Auth olduqda customer ünvanları da qaytarılır. Guest üçün token header və ya cookie ilə oxunur. payment_methods siyahısı admin tərəfindən yaradılan order_payment_methods cədvəlindən gəlir. Hər payment method üçün key, name, description, type, is_online, requires_redirect, gateway_code, icon_path və installments qaytarılır. Əgər method installment dəstəkləyirsə installments daxilində artıq hesablanmış base_total, interest_amount, total_with_interest və monthly_amount da qaytarılır. Discount hour aktivdirsə və səbətdəki məhsul və ya variation həmin kampaniyaya daxildirsə item qiymətində discount_price tətbiq olunmuş nəticə qaytarılır. Query-də delivery_price_id göndərilərsə totals.delivery_price və installments hesablaması həmin delivery price üzərindən qurulur.

elements.description: Product categories (menus.type=categories), live search, discount hours, product list, product detail, and direct checkout (buy now) APIs.
elements.basePathNote: These endpoints work under the /v1 prefix inside the route group. Product detail is a public endpoint. Buy now works for both guest users and authenticated customers. Locale is selected through the Content-Language header.

Content-Language.description: Locale header. Example: az | en | ru. Middleware sets the application locale based on this header.

Authorization.description: Bearer token for authenticated customers. It may be used during buy now requests.

X-Guest-Token.description: Guest cart token. The buy now endpoint uses a temporary cart, but this header may be sent for compatibility with other unauthenticated customer flows.

get.description: Fast live search endpoint for the site header or search input. The q value is searched in three places: active categories where menus.type=categories, active product filter values whose parent filter name or slug matches brand-related keywords, and all active published product variations. Product variation search checks name, slug, description, meta_title, meta_description, meta_keywords, sku, and model. The response is returned in a frontend-ready name + items structure where name can be rendered as a section heading.

q.description: Live search text. Minimum 2 characters and maximum 100 characters. Search is performed in brands, categories, and products sections.

limit.description: Maximum number of results per section. Default is 8 and maximum is 20.

q: Search query must be at least 2 characters.
limit: Limit may not be greater than 20.

post.description: Creates a product purchase request from the product detail popup form. This endpoint does not create an order. It stores the customer's request so that admins can review and contact the customer later. The frontend must send fullname, phone, product_variation_id, and quantity. Product name is not accepted from the frontend because product and variation data are resolved securely from product_variation_id. Authenticated customers may send Authorization: Bearer token; guest users may send X-Guest-Token or cart_token cookie. If no guest token is provided, the backend generates one automatically.
post.authorization: Public. Authorization: Bearer {token} may be sent for authenticated customers.

fullname.description: Customer full name. Minimum 2 characters and maximum 255 characters.

phone.description: Customer phone number. Accepted formats are normalized by the backend to +994XXXXXXXXX.

product_variation_id.description: Product variation ID from product detail active_variation.id or variations[].id.

quantity.description: Requested product quantity. Minimum value is 1 and maximum value is 999.

201.message: Purchase request has been submitted successfully.

phone: Phone number must be a valid Azerbaijan phone number.

get.summary: Product list with optional category, filters, search, and sorting
get.description: Returns a product list. If main_category_id is provided, products from that category and all descendant categories are included, and sidebar filters are built from that category tree. If main_category_id is not provided, the endpoint works as a global list for search, home, brand, or similar pages. When a sidebar filter is selected, both products and available filters with counts are recalculated according to the selected filters. The list is built on product variations with a 1 product = 1 default variation approach.

main_category_id.description: Main category identifier. It accepts menus.id or uuid for records where type=categories. When provided, all descendant categories are included. If omitted, the endpoint works globally.

q.description: Search text. It searches product_variation_translations.name and product_variation_translations.slug with LIKE %q%.

is_new.description: When true, only products marked as new are returned. When false, only products not marked as new are returned. If omitted, this filter is not applied.

is_popular.description: When true, only popular products are returned. When false, only non-popular products are returned. If omitted, this filter is not applied.

most_sale.description: When true, only best-selling products are returned. When false, only products not marked as best-selling are returned. If omitted, this filter is not applied.

per_page.description: Pagination page size. Maximum value is 60.

sort.description: Sort option. Allowed values: newest | name_asc | name_desc | price_asc | price_desc | popular | most_sale.

price_min.description: Minimum price filter. Applies pv.price >= price_min.

price_max.description: Maximum price filter. Applies pv.price <= price_max.

filters.description: Facet filters. Format: filters[filter_id][]=value_id. Different filters are combined with AND logic, while values inside the same filter are combined with OR logic. If main_category_id is not provided, meta.filters may be returned as an empty array because category sidebar filters are built only for a category tree.

get.description: Returns product detail by variation slug. The slug path parameter must match product_variation_translations.slug. Business rule: product detail works through product variations, and every product must have at least one variation. The response returns current_price for active_variation and also returns payment_methods calculated against the active variation's real current price. If an active discount hour exists and the variation or its product is included in the campaign, discount_price is used as current_price. If payment_methods include installments, base_total, interest_amount, total_with_interest, and monthly_amount are calculated from the active variation current_price.

post.description: Creates an order directly from the variation selected on the product detail page. The endpoint creates a temporary cart in the background, adds the selected variation to it, validates stock, creates the order, and returns the flow according to the selected payment method. Authenticated customers may send address_id. If an authenticated customer does not send address_id and does not send an address payload, the system automatically selects the default address. If the authenticated customer has no address, a validation error is returned. Guest users must send address data inside the address object. name, surname, and passport_fin are not part of the address object; they are sent as root fields and stored in the order address snapshot. Offline payment methods return a successful order response immediately. Online payment methods return the order together with a payment object and redirect_url. The existing customer or guest cart is not modified. The order in the response is returned in the extended OrderResource format, including customer, guest_token, totals.initial_payment, totals.remaining_installment_total, totals.monthly_amount, totals.payable_total, address.name, address.surname, address.passport_fin, items.image, payments, and status_histories.
post.authorization: Public. Authorization: Bearer {token} may be sent for authenticated customers.

qty.description: Product quantity. Defaults to 1 when omitted. The requested quantity cannot be greater than the variation stock.

name.description: Additional personal information for the order. It is sent as a root field, not inside the address object.

surname.description: Additional personal information for the order. It is sent as a root field, not inside the address object.

passport_fin.description: Additional personal information for the order. It is sent as a root field, not inside the address object.

address_id.description: Used only for authenticated customers. If address_id is provided, address payload must not be sent. If an authenticated customer does not provide address_id and does not provide address, the system automatically selects the default address.

address.description: Must be sent as a nested object for guest users or for authenticated customers who do not use address_id. name, surname, and passport_fin are not part of this object.

delivery_price_id.description: Required when address_id is not provided. It must be an active delivery price ID.

payment_method.description: Active payment method key from the order_payment_methods table.

payment_installment_id.description: Required when the selected payment method supports installments.

get.description: Returns all active product category menus where menus.type=categories. The response is optimized for the catalog menu UI and contains only the required fields. Language is resolved from the request header by the application locale middleware.
Returns the currently active discount hour if one exists. A discount hour is active when status=Active and starts_at <= now <= ends_at. If no active discount hour exists, data is returned as null.

Returns the active product filter whose translated name or slug matches brand-related keywords such as brand, brands, brend, brendi, brendler, brendlər, бренд, бренды, or бренди. The response uses the same product filter structure used in product list and product detail APIs. Brand values are returned from active product_filter_values of the resolved brand filter.
